faces.name: Temp of the Damned
faces.oracleText:
As this creature enters, roll a six-sided die. This creature enters with a number of funk counters on it equal to the result.
At the beginning of your upkeep, remove a funk counter from this creature. If you can't, sacrifice it.

faces.name: Temporal Adept
faces.oracleText: {U}{U}{U}, {T}: Return target permanent to its owner's hand.

faces.oracleText: {5}, {T}: Shuffle your library, then reveal the top card. Until end of turn, for as long as that card remains on top of your library, play with the top card of your library revealed and you may play that card without paying its mana cost. (If it has X in its mana cost, X is 0.)

faces.oracleText:

• Each player draws seven cards.

faces.oracleText:

faces.name: Temporal Conqueror
faces.oracleText: When this creature enters, mill three cards. Then return a land card from your graveyard to your hand. If you can't, create a Treasure token. (To mill three cards, put the top three cards of your library into your graveyard.)

faces.name: Temporal Distortion
faces.oracleText:
Whenever a creature or land becomes tapped, put an hourglass counter on it.
Each permanent with an hourglass counter on it doesn't untap during its controller's untap step.
At the beginning of each player's upkeep, remove all hourglass counters from permanents that player controls.
